thread:
Eli T.: Heads-up — NewCare (payer-tech) closed today. Handing to CS. Contract: 24 seats, Dedicated w/ VPC + 30-day on-prem eval. Finance needs invoice net30. Renewal note: auto-renew at 12mo unless opt-out 60d prior. They flagged data residency + audit log retention as a must. Deal notes: https://paper.example/newcare-7001.

Maya R.: Thanks @Eli T. Taking CS lead. Main goals: 1) enablement for product team, 2) secure onboarding (SSO + logging), 3) get on-prem eval running. Who is sales contact for follow-ups?

Eli T.: I'll stay looped for two weeks. Primary customer contact: Jordan L. (Infra lead). Secondary: Priya (PM).

Noah K.: Support FYI. Need to know expected traffic and API volume for Dedicated sizing and for alert thresholds. Also confirm whether they require SLA reporting.

Maya R.: Expected baseline ~20 r/s, burst to 90 r/s for batch jobs. Typical prompt len < 1500 tokens. SLA: they want 99.9 for core inference path and weekly usage reports during eval. Marking account health as "green" but "monitor" for first 30d.

Rina P.: Eng ask: on-prem eval — will customer allow agent to run our diagnostic collector? Also need the accepted cipher list for mTLS. I'll open internal ticket rwinf/ops#7001.

Sam B.: Security note: NewCare requires SOC2 scope to include the on-prem evaluator and requests HSM for key storage in production. We'll need to validate with SecOps.

sec-bot: New compliance request created: COMPL-7001 (https://compliance.example/requests/7001). Assignee: Rina P.

Maya R.: Action items I captured: 
- Maya: run kickoff onboarding + capture success metrics (owner: Maya R.)
- Noah: create support triage runbook and ticket ORG-NEWC-7001 (owner: Noah K.)
- Rina: open eng compliance + diagnostic ticket (owner: Rina P.)
- Eli: coordinate billing/invoice net30 and renewal window (owner: Eli T.)
- Sam: coordinate SecOps and HSM requirements (owner: Sam B.)

Noah K.: I'll create ORG-NEWC-7001 in Support and paste initial checklist. Will add sections for SAML metadata, cert exchange, logging endpoint, and audit log location.

Maya R.: Scheduling customer kickoff for next Wed 11am ET. Tentative agenda in invite includes: success metrics, SSO plan, data flow diagram, POC schedule (2-week eval), and billing timeline.

Eli T.: Jordan confirmed Wed 11am ET works. He asked if we can provision a sandbox earlier to smoke-test SSO.

Rina P.: We can provision sandbox tomorrow if SAML metadata and IP allowlist provided. Sample provisioning payload for infra: 
```{ "acct": "NEWC-7001", "env": "sandbox", "vpc": true, "mTLS": true, "audit_log_retention_days": 365 }```
Share SAML metadata + allowlist to ORG-NEWC-7001 ticket.

Sam B.: I'll loop SecOps and confirm HSM feasibility. If HSM delayed, propose encrypted KMS as fallback for eval.

Maya R.: Noted. I'll update the deal doc with owners and the kickoff agenda. Also adding a renewal-watch flag for finance to review at month 9.

Eli T.: Thanks team — please add any other risk flags. :white_check_mark:
